events.title: OMB Christmas Market
events.blurb: Opening weekend of OMB’s 15th German-style Christmas market: local makers, food and beer, and free photos with Santa Saturday 2–5 p.m. A second market runs at OMB Ballantyne (15025 Bowl St).
events.blurbEs: Primer fin de semana del 15.º mercado navideño al estilo alemán de OMB: artesanos locales, comida y cerveza, y fotos gratis con Santa el sábado de 2 a 5 p.m. Hay un segundo mercado en OMB Ballantyne (15025 Bowl St).

events.title: Hornets vs. Nets
events.blurb: The Hornets host the Brooklyn Nets on Saturday evening in Uptown.
events.blurbEs: Los Hornets reciben a los Brooklyn Nets el sábado por la tarde en Uptown.

events.title: Light the Knights
events.blurb: The Knights’ ballpark becomes a holiday festival with 250,000+ lights, an NHL-size ice rink, a 150-foot snow tubing hill and a holiday market. Hours vary by date; check the calendar.
events.blurbEs: El estadio de los Knights se convierte en un festival navideño con más de 250,000 luces, pista de hielo tamaño NHL, tobogán de nieve de 45 metros y mercado navideño. El horario varía según la fecha; consulta el calendario.

events.title: Dr. Seuss’ How the Grinch Stole Christmas in Concert
events.blurb: The Charlotte Symphony plays James Horner’s score live to the Jim Carrey film. Friday night and Saturday afternoon only.
events.blurbEs: La Sinfónica de Charlotte toca en vivo la música de James Horner con la película de Jim Carrey. Solo viernes por la noche y sábado por la tarde.

events.title: Speedway Christmas
events.blurb: Drive a light show of millions of lights around the speedway, open 6–10 p.m. rain or shine. Village Nights add the Christmas Village; the tubing hill there is $15 extra.
events.blurbEs: Recorre en auto un espectáculo de millones de luces alrededor del autódromo, de 6 a 10 p.m., llueva o no. Las Village Nights incluyen la Villa Navideña; el tobogán allí cuesta $15 adicionales.

events.title: Kannapolis Celebration of Lights
events.blurb: Free holiday lights at Village Park in Kannapolis, about 30 minutes northeast of Uptown, plus the Winterland Express train and carousel (tickets required).
events.blurbEs: Luces navideñas gratis en Village Park de Kannapolis, a unos 30 minutos de Uptown, además del tren Winterland Express y carrusel (se requieren boletos).

events.title: A Beautiful Noise
events.blurb: The touring Broadway musical about Neil Diamond’s life, packed with hits like “Sweet Caroline.” Five performances over the weekend.
events.blurbEs: El musical de Broadway en gira sobre la vida de Neil Diamond, lleno de éxitos como “Sweet Caroline”. Cinco funciones durante el fin de semana.
events.getThere: Bank of America Center Garage (entrances 150 N College St and 290 E 5th St); $10 after 5 p.m. weekdays, no time restriction on weekends.

events.title: A Motown Christmas
events.blurb: The Motortown All-Stars, with singers from groups like the Miracles and the Contours, perform Motown hits and holiday classics with a live Detroit band.
events.blurbEs: Los Motortown All-Stars, con cantantes de grupos como the Miracles y the Contours, interpretan éxitos de Motown y clásicos navideños con una banda en vivo de Detroit.
events.getThere: Levine Center for the Arts parking garage, 130 W Brooklyn Village Ave.

events.title: Eric Roberson Presents: The Greatest Gift
events.blurb: GRAMMY-nominated R&B and soul singer-songwriter Eric Roberson brings his holiday show to Uptown.
events.blurbEs: El cantautor de R&B y soul nominado al GRAMMY Eric Roberson trae su espectáculo navideño a Uptown.
events.getThere: Levine Center for the Arts parking garage, 130 W Brooklyn Village Ave.
